Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly labeled the event as the “1984 Asian Games (the 1st SAF Games)” held in Kathmandu. This conflates the Asian Games with the South Asian Games; the 1984 event in Kathmandu was the 1st South Asian Games (SAF Games), not the Asian Games. This misidentification could lead to reporting the wrong competition.
